blurb: Guests paddle or kayak down the National Scenic Little Miami River on self-guided trips. Trips range from 6 to 10 miles and take between 1.5 to 5 hours. The river offers opportunities to swim, picnic, and enjoy nature along the way.
extraNote: Reservations required · Call prior to trip to check hours, river conditions, and water levels · Cash deposit required starting at $40 per group, returned when equipment is returned on time · Lifeguards are NOT stationed along the river · Morrow Base at 219 Mill (S.R. 123), Morrow, Ohio 45152
